title: Freightliner Coronado FUPS Bullbar #4
description: Freightliner Coronado hi-tensile polished aluminium bullbar, 88mm tube, optional 100mm, main cross tubes are one piece through drilled uprights and recessed into outer uprights. No butt welds, driving light mounts to customer specs. Lower cow catcher channel with extended uprights. Reversable aluminium Load Signs as required.
